image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a meal setup. The primary subject is a black cast-iron skillet (frying pan) in the foreground containing cooked food (scrambled eggs and sliced bananas). A second similar black pan is partially visible behind it. To the left, there is a white bowl containing sliced carrots and other pale vegetables. The background appears to be a wooden surface.
